CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.apply_taxi_amount()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_mode text;
begin
  v_mode := coalesce(new.taxi_mode,new.taxi_service,'none');
  new.taxi_amount := case v_mode
    when 'pickup' then 5.00
    when 'pickup_dropoff' then 10.00
    when 'roundtrip' then 10.00
    else 0.00
  end;
  return new;
end;
$function$
functions.name: apply_taxi_amount

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_reservation_taxi()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_mode text := 'none';
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    if coalesce(new.taxi_mode, 'none') <> 'none' then
      v_mode := new.taxi_mode;
    elsif coalesce(new.taxi_service, 'none') <> 'none' then
      v_mode := case new.taxi_service
        when 'roundtrip' then 'pickup_dropoff'
        when 'pickup' then 'pickup'
        else 'none'
      end;
    end if;
  elsif new.taxi_mode is distinct from old.taxi_mode then
    v_mode := coalesce(new.taxi_mode, 'none');
  elsif new.taxi_service is distinct from old.taxi_service then
    v_mode := case new.taxi_service
      when 'roundtrip' then 'pickup_dropoff'
      when 'pickup' then 'pickup'
      else 'none'
    end;
  elsif coalesce(new.taxi_mode, 'none') <> 'none' then
    v_mode := new.taxi_mode;
  elsif coalesce(new.taxi_service, 'none') <> 'none' then
    v_mode := case new.taxi_service
      when 'roundtrip' then 'pickup_dropoff'
      when 'pickup' then 'pickup'
      else 'none'
    end;
  end if;

  new.taxi_mode := case
    when v_mode = 'pickup_dropoff' then 'pickup_dropoff'
    when v_mode = 'pickup' then 'pickup'
    else 'none'
  end;
  new.taxi_service := case
    when new.taxi_mode = 'pickup_dropoff' then 'roundtrip'
    when new.taxi_mode = 'pickup' then 'pickup'
    else 'none'
  end;
  new.taxi_amount := case
    when new.taxi_mode = 'pickup_dropoff' then 10
    when new.taxi_mode = 'pickup' then 5
    else 0
  end;
  return new;
end;
$function$
functions.name: sync_reservation_taxi

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.visit_reminder_candidates(p_day date)
 RETURNS TABLE(recipient_user_id uuid, dog_id bigint, reservation_id bigint, body text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT DISTINCT
   profile.user_id,
   d.id,
   r.id,
   'Dobrý deň, na zajtra ' || pg_catalog.to_char(p_day,'DD. MM. YYYY') ||
   ' máte rezervovaný vstup pre ' ||
   private.dog_name_accusative(coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(d.sms_name),''),d.name),d.sex) ||
   CASE
     WHEN
       lower(coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(r.taxi_mode),''),'none')) IN ('pickup_dropoff','do/zo','do-zo','roundtrip','both')
       OR lower(coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(r.taxi_service),''),'none')) IN ('pickup_dropoff','do/zo','do-zo','roundtrip','both')
       THEN ' aj s vyzdvihnutím a dovozom domov.'
     WHEN
       lower(coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(r.taxi_mode),''),'none')) IN ('pickup','do','one_way','one-way','oneway')
       OR lower(coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(r.taxi_service),''),'none')) IN ('pickup','do','one_way','one-way','oneway')
       THEN ' aj s vyzdvihnutím.'
     ELSE '.'
   END ||
   ' Pozrite si v aplikácii, kto bude s vaším psíkom v škôlke. 🐾' ||
   CASE
     WHEN r.entry_type='pass'
       THEN ' Prehľad vstupov, zostávajúcich vstupov a platnosť permanentky nájdete v aplikácii.'
     ELSE ''
   END
 FROM public.reservations r
 JOIN public.dogs d
   ON d.id=r.dog_id
  AND d.active
  AND d.visit_reminder_channel IN ('auto','both','push')
 JOIN public.customer_owner_links link ON link.owner_id=d.owner_id AND (link.allowed_dog_ids IS NULL OR d.id=ANY(link.allowed_dog_ids))
 JOIN public.customer_profiles profile
   ON profile.user_id=link.user_id
  AND profile.status='active'
 WHERE r.reservation_date=p_day
   AND r.status='booked'
   AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1
     FROM public.customer_booking_requests request
     WHERE request.reservation_id=r.id
       AND request.status='cancel_requested'
   )
   AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1
     FROM public.portal_push_subscriptions sub
     WHERE sub.user_id=profile.user_id
       AND sub.active
   );
$function$
functions.name: visit_reminder_candidates

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.build_admin_weekly_report_v307(p_week date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with dates as(select p_week+g.n as day from generate_series(0,4) as g(n)),
seen as(select v.visit_date as day,count(distinct v.dog_id)::int as total,
 count(distinct v.dog_id) filter(where v.entry_type='single')::int as single_n,
 count(distinct v.dog_id) filter(where v.entry_type='pass')::int as pass_n,
 count(distinct v.dog_id) filter(where v.entry_type='free')::int as free_n,
 count(distinct v.dog_id) filter(where v.taxi_mode in ('pickup','dropoff') and v.taxi_amount>0)::int as taxi_one,
 count(distinct v.dog_id) filter(where v.taxi_mode='pickup_dropoff' and v.taxi_amount>0)::int as taxi_both
 from public.visits v left join public.reservations r on r.id=v.reservation_id
 left join public.passes p on p.id=v.pass_id
 where v.visit_date between p_week and p_week+4
 and coalesce(r.source,'') not ilike '%test%'
 and coalesce(p.source,'') not ilike '%test%'
 and (r.id is null or r.status='attended')
 group by v.visit_date),
sales as(select purchased_on as day,count(*) filter(where total_entries=10)::int as p10,
 count(*) filter(where total_entries=20)::int as p20,
 count(*) filter(where total_entries not in(10,20))::int as pother,
 count(*) filter(where purchase_price is null)::int as unknown_price,
 coalesce(sum(purchase_price),0)::numeric(12,2) as pass_amount
 from public.passes where purchased_on between p_week and p_week+4
 and coalesce(source,'') not ilike '%test%'
 and coalesce(status,'') not in('void','cancelled')
 group by purchased_on),
j as(select d.day,coalesce(v.total,0)::int as visits,coalesce(v.single_n,0)::int as single_visits,
 coalesce(v.pass_n,0)::int as pass_visits,coalesce(v.free_n,0)::int as free_visits,
 coalesce(v.taxi_one,0)::int as taxi_one,coalesce(v.taxi_both,0)::int as taxi_both,
 f.day is not null as finance_known,
 coalesce(s.p10,0)::int as p10,coalesce(s.p20,0)::int as p20,coalesce(s.pother,0)::int as pother,
 coalesce(s.unknown_price,0)::int as unknown_price,
 (f.day is not null and f.single_count=coalesce(v.single_n,0)
  and f.taxi_amount=coalesce((select sum(v2.taxi_amount) from public.visits v2 left join public.passes p2 on p2.id=v2.pass_id left join public.reservations r2 on r2.id=v2.reservation_id where v2.visit_date=d.day and coalesce(p2.source,'') not ilike '%test%' and coalesce(r2.source,'') not ilike '%test%' and (r2.id is null or r2.status='attended')),0)) as accounting_matches,
 case when f.day is not null and coalesce(s.unknown_price,0)=0 then
 ((coalesce(f.single_count,0)*25)+coalesce(f.taxi_amount,0)+coalesce(s.pass_amount,0))::numeric(12,2)
 else null end as amount_estimate
 from dates d left join seen v using(day) left join public.daily_financials f using(day)
 left join sales s using(day)),
t as(select sum(visits)::int as visits,sum(single_visits)::int as singles,sum(pass_visits)::int as pass_visits,
 sum(free_visits)::int as free_visits,sum(taxi_one)::int as taxi_one,sum(taxi_both)::int as taxi_both,
 sum(p10)::int as p10,sum(p20)::int as p20,sum(pother)::int as pother,
 count(*) filter(where finance_known)::int as known_days,
 bool_and(accounting_matches)::boolean as accounting_matches,
 sum(unknown_price)::int as unknown_price,
 sum(amount_estimate)::numeric(12,2) as estimate from j)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'schema_version',307,'week_start',p_week,'week_end',p_week+4,
 'overview',jsonb_build_object('visits',t.visits,'single_visits',t.singles,
 'pass_visits',t.pass_visits,'free_visits',t.free_visits,
 'passes_10_recorded',t.p10,'passes_20_recorded',t.p20,'passes_other_recorded',t.pother,
 'taxi_oneway',t.taxi_one,'taxi_both',t.taxi_both,'taxi_services',t.taxi_one+t.taxi_both,
 'paid_single_sales',case when t.known_days=5 and t.accounting_matches and t.unknown_price=0 then t.singles else null end,
 'confirmed_revenue_eur',case when t.known_days=5 and t.accounting_matches and t.unknown_price=0 then t.estimate else null end,
 'accounting_estimate_eur',case when t.known_days=5 and t.unknown_price=0 and t.accounting_matches then t.estimate else null end),
 'data_quality',jsonb_build_object('financial_days',t.known_days,'financial_days_expected',5,
 'daily_accounts_match',t.accounting_matches,'paid_receipt_tracking',false,'complete',(t.known_days=5 and t.accounting_matches and t.unknown_price=0),
 'reason','Tržba podľa denného účtovania potvrdeného prevádzkovateľom; pri neúplných dňoch a rozpore nemožno potvrdiť úplný súčet.','operator_confirmed_accounting',true),
 'days',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'date',j.day,'visits',case when j.finance_known or j.visits>0 then j.visits else null end,
 'single_visits',case when j.finance_known then j.single_visits else null end,
 'pass_visits',case when j.finance_known then j.pass_visits else null end,
 'accounting_estimate_eur',case when j.accounting_matches then j.amount_estimate else null end,
 'finance_recorded',j.finance_known,'accounts_match',j.accounting_matches
 ) order by j.day),'[]'::jsonb) from j)
) from t;
$function$
functions.name: build_admin_weekly_report_v307
